subject: Research Agent 02 confirmed — opening edge to physical wake critical path
body: Slot 02 claimed after V6.8 discovery/gap scoring at current main bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea. Smooth closing is a hard regression guard; slots 01/05/07 own historical archaeology, crash forensics, and terminal reassert ordering respectively.
